Cost of each activation as terms in entity populations: a shape, not a bound.
  N(T)        entities that carry T
  N(*)        all entities, for a rule that requires no trait
  Δ(T)        entities of T whose inputs changed since the rule's last run
  k           matches per row of a join, not measured
  cells(T)    cells of each carrier of T
  live(T: f)  cells of T whose fields f are not at their defaults
  ×N          the passes of a rule with `repeat: N`
A keep rule is skipped when none of its inputs changed.

phase std.core.fixed_tick  depth 2
  report.Stand/on std.core.fixed_tick  N(Unit)·k
  report.Bruise/on report.Landed  per event: N(Unit)

phase std.core.tick  depth 2
  report.Award/on std.core.tick  1
  report.Cull/on std.core.tick  N(Unit)
  report.Flicker/on std.core.tick  N(Spark, never destroyed)
  report.Move/on std.core.tick  N(Unit)
  report.Crowd/on std.core.tick  N(Unit)·N(Unit)
  report.Clash/on std.core.tick  N(Unit)·N(Unit)
  report.PongSide/on report.Pong  per event: 1
  report.Rally/on std.core.tick  N(Unit)
  report.Recruit/on std.core.tick  1
  report.Burn/on std.core.tick  1
  report.Serve/on std.core.tick  1
  report.PingSide/on report.Ping  per event: 1
  report.Taunt/on std.core.tick  N(Unit)·2
  delayed cycle: report.PingSide/on report.Ping, report.PongSide/on report.Pong

event std.core.unload  depth 1
  std.core.SceneCleanup/on std.core.unload  per event: N(*)
